meta.themes: Frontier Model Governance, AI Talent Wars, Inference Infrastructure, Enterprise AI

news.title: OpenAI began a limited preview of GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna
news.summary: OpenAI started a government-coordinated preview of GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna, limiting initial API and Codex access to trusted partners while planning broader availability in the coming weeks.

news.title: U.S. government allowed Anthropic to restore Mythos 5 for trusted partners
news.summary: The Commerce Department authorized Anthropic to redeploy Claude Mythos 5 to roughly 100 trusted U.S. companies and federal agencies, partially reversing the June 12 export-control suspension while Fable 5 remained offline.

news.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveiled Jalapeño, an LLM-optimized inference chip
news.summary: OpenAI and Broadcom introduced Jalapeño, OpenAI's first custom inference accelerator, co-developed in nine months and designed to improve performance per watt for frontier LLM serving at gigawatt scale.

news.title: Samsung Electronics deployed ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex company-wide
news.summary: Samsung Electronics rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to all employees in Korea and all Device eXperience staff worldwide, marking one of OpenAI's largest enterprise deployments to date.

news.title: Google lost multiple senior AI researchers to Anthropic and OpenAI
news.summary: Bloomberg and Business Insider reported that Nobel laureate John Jumper, Gemini researchers Jonas Adler and Alexander Pritzel, and former Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer were leaving Google for Anthropic and OpenAI.

news.title: Google delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro to July
news.summary: Business Insider reported that Google pushed Gemini 3.5 Pro's general availability from June into July to gather more early-tester feedback and refine long-horizon agentic performance.

news.title: NVIDIA positioned Vera Rubin for world-class science supercomputers
news.summary: At ISC High Performance 2026, NVIDIA said Vera Rubin NVL4 systems will deliver exascale-class AI for science workloads including climate modeling, CFD, and energy exploration, with OEM availability expected in Q4.

news.title: Anthropic introduced Claude Tag for multiplayer Slack workflows
news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Tag in beta for Enterprise and Team customers, letting teams tag @Claude in Slack channels for asynchronous, shared agent work with scoped tools and channel memory.

news.title: U.S. lawmakers introduced the AI Incident Reporting Act
news.summary: A bipartisan bill would require developers of covered frontier models to report major safety and security incidents to the Commerce Department within seven days, with penalties up to $2 million per violation.

news.title: OpenAI expanded Daybreak for end-to-end cyber defense
news.summary: OpenAI broadened its Daybreak initiative with GPT-5.5-Cyber, Codex Security workflows, a cyber partner program, and Patch the Planet to help defenders validate vulnerabilities and accelerate patching.

news.title: General Intuition raised $320 million at a $2.3 billion valuation
news.summary: General Intuition closed a Khosla Ventures-led round to scale compute for its action foundation models trained on gameplay data, aiming to generalize from video games to robotics and simulation.

news.title: Taktile raised $110 million to automate bank and insurance decisions
news.summary: Taktile closed a Goldman Sachs Alternatives-led Series C to expand AI agents that automate high-stakes financial decisions for banks and insurers across the U.S., Europe, and Latin America.
